note: GENERATED — do not edit. One revision per printable part: rev bumps when the part's printed shape moved (fingerprint within `tolerance`), src is the digest of the sources that draw it, history[].changes says what moved — knobs, deltas, commits, and `regions`, boxes in the STL's own coordinates where the new surface is not where the old one was, for a viewer to tint. The recipes are render.sh's and gen_enclosures.py's, recorded from the scripts themselves; a committed part's earlier revs are read out of git (introduced_in names the commit). Provenance, not authenticity: a rev proves which design a mesh is, never who printed it.
